title: Unclear impact and influence
summary: It is unclear what impact my actions will make and whether or how I can influence things I care about.

title: Unclear personal priorities
summary: It is unclear what I care about—how to take the time to figure out what I care about, what values I have, and what I need.

title: Too busy to participate
summary: I am so busy focusing on basic survival tasks, and people are too busy with work and necessary chores or errands, to participate in their cities or communities.

title: Unclear participation options
summary: It is unclear what options are available, in breadth and depth, for how I can participate: events, actions, and so on; how long they will take; how they fit into my schedule; and how they make an impact.
